description: List the locations BuyUKeSIM travel eSIM data plans currently cover, with how many plans each has and the from-price in USD. Each entry is a country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code) or a region (our own regional bundle code, e.g. A1 Africa, EU Europe); structuredContent marks which with kind. The plan count equals what search_esim_plans returns for that code.
name: list_covered_countries

kind.description: country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. region: our own regional bundle code, e.g. A1 Africa, EU Europe.

name.description: Bundle name for a region; null for a country.

plan_count.description: Equals the number of plans search_esim_plans returns for this code.
